findings.highlight: disperses as soon as it touches outside air.
findings.evidenceJa: 元からそうであると言うように、ザラザラと散っていった。
findings.governingReading: it scatters grainily, as though that had always been its natural state.
findings.explanation: The projection’s gritty dissolution and uncanny return to an apparently original state are omitted.

findings.highlight: loud footsteps
findings.evidenceJa: 慌ただしい足音
findings.governingReading: hurried footsteps
findings.explanation: Urgency is replaced by volume.

findings.highlight: She appears in the terrace
findings.evidenceJa: 二階のテラスに現れると
findings.governingReading: She appears on the second-floor terrace
findings.explanation: The vertical origin of Rin’s jump is omitted.

findings.highlight: After looking at Tohsaka once
findings.evidenceJa: 遠く遠坂を見た後
findings.governingReading: After looking at Tohsaka in the distance
findings.explanation: Distance is misread as occurrence count.

findings.highlight: steps back as if to exit the stage.
findings.evidenceJa: 一歩、退場するように踵を返す。
findings.governingReading: turns on his heel, taking one step as though making his exit.
findings.explanation: Archer’s decisive theatrical turn becomes a backward step.

findings.highlight: should be turned into junk.
findings.evidenceJa: 疾くゴミになるがいい
findings.governingReading: hurry and become garbage.
findings.explanation: Gilgamesh’s contemptuous command and urgency are weakened.

findings.highlight: the hall filled with Archer’s blood.
findings.evidenceJa: アーチャーの鮮血がこびりついた広間
findings.governingReading: the hall with Archer’s fresh blood caked onto it.
findings.explanation: Caked blood marking the impact sites becomes a hall filled with blood.

findings.highlight: is silent, wondering how best to attack the enemy.
findings.evidenceJa: 唇を堅く閉じ、敵に向かう機会を見定めている。
findings.governingReading: keeps her lips tightly shut, measuring the moment to move against the enemy.
findings.explanation: Saber’s controlled wait for an opening becomes uncertainty about attack method.

findings.highlight: With Archer’s death, Tohsaka
findings.evidenceJa: アーチャーを失った遠坂
findings.governingReading: Tohsaka, having lost Archer
findings.explanation: Loss of Archer is promoted into confirmed death before the scene establishes his final state.

findings.highlight: magical energy released from the jewel
findings.evidenceJa: 宝石に籠めた魔力を叩き込むだけ
findings.governingReading: simply slamming the magical energy stored in the jewel into the target
findings.explanation: Rin’s direct, forceful discharge is weakened to energy being released.

findings.highlight: He will kill you if you attack him recklessly
findings.evidenceJa: 手を出せば殺されます
findings.governingReading: If you make a move against him, you will be killed.
findings.explanation: “Recklessly” invents a suggestion that a cautious attack might be safe.

findings.highlight: so you are her Master now?
findings.evidenceJa: 今のマスターはその小娘か。
findings.governingReading: so that little girl is your current Master?
findings.explanation: Gilgamesh’s question about Rin being Saber’s Master is reversed into Saber being Rin’s Master.

findings.highlight: Then I shall overlook your rudeness.
findings.evidenceJa: ならば今の無礼は不問に付す。
findings.governingReading: Then I shall overlook that girl’s insolence just now.
findings.explanation: The possessive “your” assigns Rin’s attack to Saber in the English exchange.

findings.highlight: That is wrong.
findings.evidenceJa: 何故も何もあるまい。
findings.governingReading: There is no “why” about it.
findings.explanation: Gilgamesh’s dismissal of Saber’s question becomes a claim that she stated something factually wrong.

findings.highlight: the Master.
findings.evidenceJa: 依り代となった魔術師だ。
findings.governingReading: the magus serving as the anchor or vessel.
findings.explanation: The technical anchor relation and magus category are reduced to the role-label Master.

findings.highlight: my Master was exceptional.
findings.evidenceJa: なかなかに筋金の入った男だった
findings.governingReading: my Master was a thoroughly hardened or dyed-in-the-wool man.
findings.explanation: Gilgamesh’s characterization of his former Master’s extreme nature becomes generic excellence.

findings.highlight: Saber hangs her head at the words “ten years ago”.
findings.evidenceJa: 彼女は痛ましげに眼を伏せた。
findings.governingReading: At the words “ten years ago,” she lowers her eyes in pain.
findings.explanation: Saber’s specifically pained recollection becomes a generic head movement.

findings.highlight: I know what that thing is.
findings.evidenceJa: アレが何であるか、我は誰よりも熟知している。
findings.governingReading: I know what that thing is better than anyone.
findings.explanation: Gilgamesh’s claim to unrivaled knowledge is omitted.

findings.highlight: a parasite like my Master.
findings.evidenceJa: マスターなどという寄生動物
findings.governingReading: parasitic creatures called Masters
findings.explanation: Gilgamesh condemns Masters as a category; the English narrows the insult to his own Master.

findings.highlight: The biggest obstacle, the summoner, was eliminated.
findings.evidenceJa: 最大の障害であった召喚者も先ほど消えた。
findings.governingReading: The summoner who was the greatest obstacle disappeared only moments ago.
findings.explanation: The immediate timing and non-agentive disappearance of Kirei are omitted or changed.

findings.highlight: All that’s left are pathetic magi that would be completely unsuited to being the vessel.
findings.evidenceJa: 残ったモノは依り代にもならぬ魔術師もどきだけだ。
findings.governingReading: All that remains is a single pseudo-magus unfit even to serve as an anchor.
findings.explanation: One remaining false magus and the technical anchoring function become plural magi judged as Grail vessels.

findings.highlight: Such failures are suited for my wish.
findings.evidenceJa: その成り損ないこそが相応しい。
findings.governingReading: That failed specimen is precisely what suits my desire.
findings.explanation: The singular person selected for Gilgamesh’s plan becomes a plural class.

findings.highlight: One would feel uncomfortable
findings.evidenceJa: 生きた心地なんてしない。
findings.governingReading: One would scarcely feel alive under such a gaze.
findings.explanation: Existential terror is weakened to discomfort.

findings.highlight: The seven Servants are sacrifices they prepared.
findings.evidenceJa: 七人のサーヴァントとはな、もともと聖杯にくべられる生け贄
findings.governingReading: The seven Servants were originally sacrifices to be fed into the Holy Grail.
findings.explanation: The English says the magi prepared the Servants themselves rather than describing their ritual function.

findings.highlight: turns the soul into pure magical energy.
findings.evidenceJa: 本人でなければ制御できぬ力
findings.governingReading: power that no one but its owner can control
findings.explanation: The defining reason a soul requires filtration—only its owner can control its power—is omitted.

findings.highlight: it should let you grant any wish.
findings.evidenceJa: 確かにそれならば願いは叶おう。
findings.governingReading: With that, a wish could indeed be granted.
findings.explanation: A general possibility becomes a second-person mechanism for granting any wish.

findings.highlight: more magical energy than a magus could ever use within his lifetime.
findings.evidenceJa: 永遠に使い切れぬ魔力量
findings.governingReading: an amount of magical energy they could never exhaust, even eternally.
findings.explanation: An inexhaustible quantity is weakened to one person’s lifetime limit.

findings.highlight: Butdo not worry, Saber.
findings.evidenceJa: だが安心しろ、セイバー。
findings.governingReading: But do not worry, Saber.
findings.explanation: Missing spacing fuses “But” and “do.”

findings.highlight: is a genius.
findings.evidenceJa: 間違いなく神域の天才だろうよ。
findings.governingReading: must unquestionably have been a genius in the divine domain.
findings.explanation: The near-divine scale of the founder’s genius is omitted.

findings.highlight: Weaponare you saying
findings.evidenceJa: 兵器聖杯が
findings.governingReading: A weapon—the Holy Grail
findings.explanation: Missing punctuation fuses “Weapon” and “are.”

findings.highlight: an embodiment of the evil in all human
findings.evidenceJa: 人間全ての悪意の具現
findings.governingReading: the embodiment of all humanity’s malice
findings.explanation: The English leaves the ungrammatical phrase “all human.”

findings.highlight: AAre you stupid!?
findings.evidenceJa: ば馬鹿じゃないのアンタ
findings.governingReading: A-Are you stupid!?
findings.explanation: Rin’s stammer is fused into “AAre.”

findings.highlight: me, who he said is a failure.
findings.evidenceJa: ヤツの言う落第者であろう俺
findings.governingReading: me, who would presumably count among the failures he describes.
findings.explanation: Shirou’s inference that the category includes him becomes a direct prior statement by Gilgamesh.

findings.highlight: a reaper that strikes down all humans equally.
findings.evidenceJa: 全ての人間に等しくおちる死の咎。
findings.governingReading: a punishment of death falling equally upon every human being.
findings.explanation: An impersonal universal death sentence becomes a personified reaper.

findings.highlight: But thenit seems a worse faker
findings.evidenceJa: 尤もそれ以上に質が悪い偽物が
findings.governingReading: Though it seems an even lower-quality faker
findings.explanation: Missing spacing fuses “then” and “it.”

findings.highlight: I will my broken legs to stand, but they do not move.
findings.evidenceJa: 折れた足はぴくりとも動いてくれない。
findings.governingReading: my broken leg will not move so much as a twitch.
findings.explanation: A singular broken leg becomes both legs.

findings.highlight: So whywhy
findings.evidenceJa: なのにどうして
findings.governingReading: So why
findings.explanation: The repeated fused “whywhy” is unsupported.

findings.highlight: The ashes will dirty me.
findings.evidenceJa: 煤で汚れる。
findings.governingReading: The soot will soil me.
findings.explanation: The fine black soot motivating Gilgamesh’s withdrawal becomes ashes.

findings.highlight: The third floor is burning down
findings.evidenceJa: 城の三階は炎で包まれ
findings.governingReading: the castle’s third floor is enveloped in flame
findings.explanation: Being surrounded by fire is strengthened into structural destruction.

findings.highlight: because he was going to get dirty from the ashes.
findings.evidenceJa: 煤で汚れるなんて理由で
findings.governingReading: for the reason that soot would dirty him.
findings.explanation: The exact petty concern about soot is again changed to ashes.

findings.highlight: the terrace that isn’t yet burning.
findings.evidenceJa: 火の手のないテラス
findings.governingReading: a terrace untouched by the flames.
findings.explanation: “Not yet” adds a forecast that this terrace will burn.

findings.highlight: The gorgeous castle shows no traces of what it used to be.
findings.evidenceJa: 絢爛だった城に、かつての面影はない。
findings.governingReading: The once-splendid castle retains no trace of its former appearance.
findings.explanation: The English awkwardly calls the currently ruined castle gorgeous rather than locating splendor in its past.
